changed_factors: Extend RHBI from rhbi-v11 to rhbi-v12 under one global clock-free, schedule-free, shape-gate-free recipe by introducing (1) valley-gated cluster-scale KDE density-ratio sparse-mode support completion (rhbi_support_completion=true) with local cross-horizon expansion while preserving true intra-mode Feydy self-coupling scale and active debiasing restoration, (2) coordinate-whitened multi-scale conditional IMQ-CMMD fibre transport (rhbi_cond_ot_mode='diag_imq_cmmd') paired with conditional CMMD residual generator DualNorm step damping (rhbi_cond_step_damp=0.68) and regularized coordinate-whitened particle AE reconstruction cost (rhbi_ae_coord_whiten=true), and (3) intrinsic k-NN Gram PCA 1D curve manifold chart settling (rhbi_simplex_curve_settle=true) with Sinkhorn medoid vertex anchoring, global MDS + spectral collinearity chart regularization, and Schmitt-trigger SBNP thermal-lock hysteresis.
mechanism_rationale: In rhbi-v11 (readout-4301e02799ec0ad34cc958a1), three orthogonal geometric bottlenecks remained across counted and stretch Tier 2 tasks: (1) on counted vector_unequal_mass (weights [0.65, 0.25, 0.08, 0.02]), global 25th-quantile NN horizon ell_t tracks dense majority clusters so rare 2% mode Poisson singletons fall outside the active screening horizon while active fraction a_f collapses to ~0; valley-gated KDE density-ratio support completion (rhbi_support_completion=true) locally expands active cross-horizon ell_xy around sparse real points while keeping true intra-mode ell_t on Feydy self-coupling c_phys_xx and restoring a_f debiasing, while remaining identically zero on equal-mass mixtures; (2) on stretch model_ae_ddgan_bimodal_chain, multi-step conditional reverse transitions exhibit anisotropic per-axis innovation scales and constant-LR DualNorm terminal chatter alongside low-variance latent AE coordinates; coordinate-whitened conditional IMQ-CMMD (diag_imq_cmmd), conditional residual generator step damping (rhbi_cond_step_damp=0.68), and coordinate-whitened AE reconstruction (rhbi_ae_coord_whiten=true) resolve both conditional chain accuracy and paired reconstruction; (3) on stretch interp_sparse_arc, local inverse-quartic MDS chart weights fold 1D open curves in 2D latent space and single-step thermal scale creep across SBNP's s=1e-4 boundary triggers an 8000x repulsion discontinuity; intrinsic 1D k-NN Gram PCA curve settling (rhbi_simplex_curve_settle=true) aligns collinear 1D geodesic charts and locks hysteresis once s_t <= 1e-4 while remaining identically zero on 2D sheets and image manifolds.
